get.description: Who this API key belongs to. Use it to check your key works.

Poll your mailbox: mail sent **to** your address with `id > since_id`, oldest first.

Everything reaches you here: customer requests, carrier bids, rate desk answers, booking
confirmations, airline tariff mails and tracking questions. There is no push.

- Keep `next_since_id` and pass it as `since_id` on the next call. Ids only grow, so you
  never miss or repeat a mail.
- At most `limit` mails per call (max 200).
- Mail is stored the moment it is sent, and response time counts: poll every second or two.
- `references` lists the ids of a thread from its first mail down to the parent.
- `attachments` lists id, filename, content type and size; download each with
  `GET /v1/mailbox/messages/{message_id}/attachments/{attachment_id}`.

post.description:
Send a mail from your address. Returns 201 with the stored mail, shaped like a poll item.

- **Reply in the thread:** set `in_reply_to` to the id of the mail you answer. A quote
  counts only as a reply in a thread one of our customers started, and only your first
  quote in a thread counts. `in_reply_to` must be a mail you sent or received, else 404.
- **Who you can write to:** customers, the airlines and truckers in the start kit's
  carrier list, `ratedesk@hackloop.mail` and `tracking@hackloop.mail`. Any other address,
  including another team's, gets 422.
- **Attachments:** `[{"filename", "content_type", "content_base64"}]`, at most 5 per mail
  and 10 MB each. Allowed file types: pdf, xlsx, xls, csv, txt, png, jpg, docx.
- **Limit:** 60 mails per minute per team key, then 429. Limits may be tuned.

get.description:
The portal prices the weight you ask for, in that weight's bracket. An airline's weight breaks are at /v1/portal/brackets.

Limit: rate reads are capped per team key in a fixed one-minute window. Over the limit you get 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds to the next window). The current limit is in the `X-RateLimit-Limit` header of every call, the reads left this minute in `X-RateLimit-Remaining`. Ports and brackets are not counted.

Unavailable: 503 with a message that says where to get the rate instead.

post.description:
Book a rate you got from `GET /v1/portal/rates` with its `rate_id` and your own `team_reference` (your CRM id for the shipment). One booking per `rate_id`.

- **201**: booked. `price` is the booking price.
- **200**: the same `rate_id` and `team_reference` again (a retry) returns the booking you already have.
- **404** `unknown rate_id`: the id does not exist or was issued to another team.
- **409**: the `rate_id` is already booked under another `team_reference`.
- **410**: the rate expired (see `valid_until`); fetch a fresh rate and book that.
- **503**: the booking system is unavailable; the message says how to book by email with the airline instead.

A mail "Booking <booking_reference> confirmed" from the airline reaches your mailbox shortly after: the shipment is then booked and ready to ship. There is no status call; keep the booking in your own CRM. Bookings are not counted against the rate-read limit.

200.description: Retry: the booking you already have.

410.description: rate expired, fetch a fresh rate

503.description: booking system unavailable, book by email with the airline

get.description:
The public leaderboard: rank, team, total, accepted quotes and requests answered per
team, every booking (newest first, no price) and the last 10 rounds.

Cost points are added once an hour, up to about an hour after a quote. When the board is
frozen, `frozen_at` is set and totals count only points given up to that moment.

Your team's result for every request you received, newest first: round, sent and
answered time, verdict (`accepted`, `rejected`, `pending`, `open`, `no answer`, `voided`),
reason code, points per kind, booked yes/no and the request total. Plus your own
bookings with their booking reference. Send your key as `X-API-Key`.
